speaker: Reeve Tamsin
description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9): Millford's reeve. She asks about the Barrow Fields' wolves (outcome barrow: starts quest.barrow_fields) and the dammed Millrace (outcome millrace: starts quest.millrace), and thanks the giant once either is done. Hostile, she takes 2 iron to make good the damage (outcome reconcile_millford). W23 (P39f; plan §5.10): after the raid on Millford (event.millford_raid) her greeting changes - burned (the raid fell: world.millford.burned) she speaks of the houses lost, defended (world.millford.defended) she thanks the giant for the hamlet; a burned Millford comes first, since its houses stay burned.

nodes.text: A giant in Millford... Mind the houses, please. I'm Tamsin, reeve here. We're millers and shepherds - we want no trouble.
Wolves out of the Barrow Fields take our sheep, and an old ogre runs with them. And the flood rolled boulders into the Millrace above us: the mill stands still.
Millford is in your debt, giant. The sheep sleep easy and the wheel turns.
The raiders came up the east road and put our houses to the torch. Two families sleep in the mill now. We'll build again - Millford always has.

choices.text: Is there anything else troubling Millford?

nodes.text: You stood between Millford and the raiders, giant. Every house still has its roof, and every door here is open to you.

choices.text: Is there anything else troubling Millford?

nodes.text: Get away from Millford! Haven't you done enough?
...Very well. Millford forgives you. Mind the houses.
